status: illustrative synthetic assumptions; not real operator data
forecast_method: one-day seasonal naive baseline (same cluster/hour, previous day)
important_limitations: Heuristic dispatch, not MILP solver output
No trained TFT/XGBoost model; forecast is seasonal-naive
No live IEX bids or market integration; market prices are synthetic
No physical pack reassignment or inter-hub pack transport implemented
No inter-metro energy transfer; each metro is modelled independently
No fixed O&M, capex, taxes or depreciation; gross contribution is not EBITDA
Loss metric is a simplified model proxy and should not be compared directly with the case 10% loss figure
Synthetic rule-based baseline is not calibrated to reproduce the case-reported 78% reliability
Battery allocation is a configurable 70:30 simulation assumption, not an optimisation-solver assignment
5% storage-energy reserve is enforced; separate swap-pack inventory is outside the model
Triple-scarcity comparison is an explanatory marginal-cost lens; customer delay/detour cost is not calibrated as a full objective term
